schema_status: PENDING: H2 contracts under repair; layout here is provisional and NOT normalized or validated against @domino/contracts
timezone_convention: SEC acceptance times assumed US Eastern (EST, UTC-5 on both dates), read from EDGAR index pages via a summarising reader, not independently confirmed. PR Newswire times (S7, S8) carry explicit -05:00 offsets in the raw page JSON-LD.
normalization_needed: source.published_at carries an offset; contract may want separate date + time + timezone
reported_unit is free text here; contract likely wants an enum plus multiplier
facts with text-only values (F22, F23, F26) need a non-numeric fact type or move to assumptions
derived facts carry derived_from IDs and inherit the latest input available_at
facts with reported_unit 'percent' (F16) carry cents null; contract needs a non-money numeric type
availability: separate issuer_public_at and sec_available_at where they differ (S3/S8)
reader-extracted quotes (F18-F23, F27-F30) need a quote_fidelity flag
reconciliations_note: Re-run 2026-10-24 on the repaired bundle with integer arithmetic; S1 inputs are reader-extracted, cross-checked to S7 raw bytes

no_hash: S1 10-Q (sec.gov 403 to curl; reader view is model-processed)

open_gaps: S1 Item 2 MD&A not returned by the reader (text ended in Note 10): explicit 12-month sufficiency sentence unverified (F32)
Note 8 quotes are reader-extracted fragments, not byte-verified (F18-F23, F27-F30)
SEC acceptance times come from reader summaries of index pages
A1 and R1 are analyst constructs; A1 feasibility unknown
